title: Kubernetes platforms
lead: Production clusters you can operate: design, build, hardening and handover, in a repository your organisation owns.
capsule: Prodory designs and builds production Kubernetes platforms on bare metal, virtual machines or managed services (EKS, AKS, GKE). The work covers cluster topology, network policy with Cilium eBPF where it fits, the platform layer and day-2 runbooks. Every component is code in repositories your team owns, and the handover includes a scored readiness checklist.
why: Most organisations running containers in production have thin platform teams, so clusters drift from their design.
CPU overprovisioning across clusters rose sharply in 2025 and 2026 telemetry studies, which points to architecture drift rather than normal headroom.
scope: Cluster design for bare metal, VMs, or EKS, AKS and GKE
Networking and policy, including Cilium eBPF where it fits
Platform layer: ingress, observability, secrets management and GitOps delivery
Day-2 runbooks and an on-call handover
outcomes: Terraform modules and cluster repositories in your organisation
A production readiness checklist, scored at handover
Your team trained to operate the platform

faqs.q: Do you run clusters on our own hardware?
faqs.a: Yes. We design for bare-metal Linux, KubeVirt and managed Kubernetes services, and choose the target with you based on residency, cost and team skills.

faqs.q: Who operates the cluster after handover?
faqs.a: Your team. The handover includes repositories, runbooks and a readiness checklist. Any ongoing support is a separate, written agreement.
